PM Modi's Seychelles Visit: Typos Spark Questions, Pacts Signed

Prime Minister Narendra Modi visited Seychelles to attend its Golden Jubilee celebrations and receive a presidential honor. The visit saw the signing of 19 pacts between India and Seychelles across various sectors. However, social media users raised questions about the authenticity of the citation for the honor due to spelling errors, with some speculating about AI use.
